selection: Fixed three tree families with pre-prediction exchange, auditor, restructuring and SIC context versus the previous corrected financial/text baseline. Same development companies, labels, weights and calibration folds. No threshold relaxation or final scoring. Context liquidity negation is corrected before fitting: not having sufficient cash remains a warning.
final_gate: Require complete source acquisition, frozen model selection, minimum support, feasible development threshold and independently reviewed current final labels before one-use final scoring.
limits: Development reuse and model selection are optimistic; source weights do not correct outcome censoring. No automatic production promotion.
